criteria.description: Starts by ruling out an instrumentation/tracking/pipeline/definition artifact before theorizing about real causes.
Localizes the drop by segmenting (device/browser, app version, geography, channel, new vs returning, payment method) rather than only listing global causes.
Aligns the drop against a change log / deploys / experiments / external events (even though 'nothing obvious shipped', checks systematically).
Considers mix shift (composition change, e.g. a traffic-source change) as a cause where no single segment got worse.
Produces ranked/prioritized hypotheses, each paired with how to check it, and indicates where to start — rather than an unordered guess list.
